operations.description: Fold four exit-condition comments onto their IF lines, restoring refine.md to its 466-line budget without moving the baseline

edits.find:
# Exit condition 1: approved
IF decision == "APPROVED" AND last_score >= 90 AND critical_major_count == 0:
edits.replace: IF decision == "APPROVED" AND last_score >= 90 AND critical_major_count == 0:  # exit 1: approved

edits.find:
# Exit condition 2: iteration cap reached
IF iteration >= MAX_ITER:
edits.replace: IF iteration >= MAX_ITER:  # exit 2: iteration cap reached

edits.find:
# Exit condition 3: fundamental rejection (not fixable by iteration)
IF decision == "REJECTED" AND iteration >= 3:
edits.replace: IF decision == "REJECTED" AND iteration >= 3:  # exit 3: fundamental rejection, not fixable by iteration

edits.find:
# Exit condition 4: stagnation — another planner round cannot buy a higher score
IF iteration >= 2 AND last_score <= iteration_history[-2].score:
edits.replace: IF iteration >= 2 AND last_score <= iteration_history[-2].score:  # exit 4: stagnation, another round cannot buy a higher score
